deposits.notes: DataCite's title search identified this preprint, already used as the source manuscript in retrieval.json. The landing page and https://arxiv.org/pdf/2504.13868 both returned HTTP 200. The PDF was downloaded only into memory: 1,970,703 bytes, 53 pages, byte-for-byte identical to the local source PDF by SHA-256 comparison. Content-Disposition names the file 2504.13868v2.pdf. The landing page identifies v2 as revised 16 March 2026 and links one current PDF; the PDF has zero embedded file attachments. n_files counts that current PDF, not historical versions. Supplementary Materials are appended on pp. 28-53: persona taxonomy, prompts, persona descriptions and example AI-generated plots (pp. 29-38), aggregate statistics and figures (pp. 39-42, 52-53), and recruitment/interface materials (pp. 43-51). The flags concern individual human participant records: the document describes arms and prints aggregate results, but contains no participant IDs, participant-to-arm mapping, individual scores, or human-written story texts. It does contain AI stimulus examples, including examples displayed in screenshots; these are materials, not the human outcomes. S1 and S2 are covered only by materials/aggregate summaries. The statement on p. 31 offers the full AI plot list from the corresponding author; it does not offer the S2 participant data. No analysis-code files or separate dataset links were found.

notes:
Checked 2026-10-09. Read all 110,238 characters of the saved markdown, including the complete appended Supplementary Materials; verified relevant PDF text and visually inspected the image-only experimental screenshots on pp. 44-51 in memory. Quotations preserve the paper's wording; line wrapping is collapsed and PDF font ligatures are expanded to their printed letters. The p. 44 consent passage was transcribed from the screenshot. The two bibliographic statements about NLTK and the OSF/PsyArXiv preprint, and Table 2's reference to Doshi and Hauser's supplement, are explicitly identified as references to external resources rather than c128 data/code deposits.

No public participant-level data were found for the randomized human study S2. S1 is model-only. The sole confirmed public resource contains the paper and its supplementary materials, so the status is code_or_materials_only, not public participant data. There is no explicit availability statement for the S2 participants' stories, individual scores, treatment assignments, exclusions or take-up records, and no study-specific data/code repository URL or preregistration link in the source manuscript. forms/c128.json has empty data_and_code.data_url and code_url fields. The p. 31 corresponding-author statement is confined to the AI-generated plot pool; it does not justify classifying human participant data as on_request. The consent statement about anonymous storage does not itself establish either public availability or restricted access.

No public data columns or participant rows could be inspected. The available materials therefore do not enable a participant-level reanalysis of the missing arm summaries, exact regression standard errors, story diversity or analyzed counts, or resolution of final.open_items about the Tables 5-6 grouping, plot take-up, conflicting story-level ANOVA, original assignment counts, exclusions, the ten-word task, or Bayesian analysis level. Published aggregate tables are not a substitute for the missing human records.

Publisher check: https://doi.org/10.1016/j.chbah.2026.100289 returned HTTP 200 at https://linkinghub.elsevier.com/retrieve/pii/S294988212600040X, which was a redirect/locator page rather than article text. The actual landing page https://www.sciencedirect.com/science/article/pii/S294988212600040X returned HTTP 403; stopped there. Its data-availability statement and supplementary-file inventory could not be checked. That unverified publisher resource is not counted as a confirmed deposit. Overall confidence is medium because this leaves a material gap; the result does not prove that no deposit exists anywhere.

Title, earlier-title, and first-author searches were completed through DataCite, Zenodo, Harvard Dataverse and OSF using urllib with User-Agent atlas-screening/0.1, without authentication. Search result counts are API totals, not counts of relevant datasets. DataCite's 154-result reversed-name query and OSF's 35-result public user-name query were fully paginated. Zenodo's initial page-size validation errors and transient timeouts were resolved with anonymous default-size queries; these attempts are documented in searches. No relevant OSF node, Dataverse dataset, Zenodo record, Figshare record, Dryad dataset, Mendeley deposit or GitHub repository was identified for file-level inspection. No GitHub API requests were made. The paper's OSF DOI is a reference to Moon et al. (2025), not to c128 data.
